name: Tax line
description: Per-passenger tax line item. One entry per pax × tax-code, summed by the offer aggregator. Maps directly to NDC OrderTotal.Taxes.Tax.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Tax code per the route table — IATA short code (US, AY, ZP, GST, …).

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Tax amount per passenger in pointOfSale currency.

fields.name: paxId
fields.description: Which passenger this line is for.

fields.name: appliesTo
fields.description: Optional segment identifier when the tax is segment-scoped.

fields.name: rateKind
fields.description: Optional — "flat" / "percent" / "per-segment". Authored by the lookup row.
